mean-reversion.description: Take the opposite side of a swing when the model's shrunk fair value crosses back through 0.50.

value.label: Quiet value
value.description: No swing needed. Buy the side with the largest modelled edge after fees whenever the spread is tight and there is real book depth.

resolution-hold.label: Resolution hold
resolution-hold.description: Buy the side already trading above 0.85 with a tight spread, betting on a clean yes/no resolution. Small payout, frequent wins, occasional total loss.

shortlist.model: fair = (book mid before the move + book mid now) / 2; the model assumes half of a move is an overreaction. Edge is measured against the executable price (YES ask, or 1 - YES bid for NO) and Kalshi's published taker fee 0.07 * C * P * (1 - P) with the schedule's default multiplier M = 1: this module works offline from the snapshot, which carries no per-series fee_multiplier field (the trading engine and the paper ledger read it from GET /series; see the Flagged for Review page for the PDF-vs-API disagreement this follows).

model_inputs.fee: 0.07 * C * P * (1 - P), Kalshi published taker fee
model_inputs.reference: the order book only; both ends of every comparison are book mids so a traded price is never compared with a book quote
